verbs.name: screen_record.render_cache_preview
verbs.description: List old recording renders and their size. Only independently owned, unchanged renders unused by this project's clips and inputs are removable; legacy renders stay kept.
verbs.result: {files:[{name,bytes,size_is_recorded?,reason,removable}],bytes,plan_id,removable_files,legacy:{files,bytes,reveal_asset,reason}} — names are relative to the project, never absolute paths; a render recorded for another project at the same folder is kept. Review the list before render_cache_remove.

verbs.name: screen_record.render_cache_remove
verbs.description: Remove only the independently owned recording renders in an unchanged preview. Rechecks all clips and original inputs; changed files and unproven ownership are kept. Undo can rebuild removed renders with Update video.
verbs.result: {results:[{status,bytes?,reason?,message}]} — each removed or kept render is reported; preview again after a refusal.

verbs.name: screen_record.camera_reset
verbs.description: Restore this camera slice's recorded look and rebased keys; returns op_ids and project_revision.

verbs.name: screen_record.zoom_list
verbs.description: List take zooms in recording/timeline time, stale state and missing-video recovery. Old clips have no take.
verbs.result: {clip, take, source:{w,h}, duration_ms, segments:[{id,start_ms,end_ms,scale,cx,cy,ramp_in_ms,ramp_out_ms,origin,timeline:{start_ms,end_ms}|null}], stale, applied_plan, pending_plan, missing_video, missing_video_reason, next_action} — missing_video is true when the current baked file is absent; reason and next_action are strings then (Update video rebuilds it), otherwise null.

verbs.name: screen_record.zoom_add
verbs.description: Add a manual zoom: exactly one of recording at_ms or absolute timeline_ms. Maps trim/speed/ramp/reverse; outside/frozen positions refuse with next action. Defaults: 2000ms, 2x, pointer, ramps 550/500ms. One op; Update video before export.

verbs.name: screen_record.zoom_update
verbs.description: Edit a zoom in recording ms; pins manual in one op. target:pointer overrides cx/cy with the last pointer sample at start (center fallback), normalized/clamped at scale. Update video before export.

verbs.name: screen_record.zoom_remove
verbs.description: Remove recording zoom ids (id or ids). Appends one resolved-list op; Update video first before export.

verbs.name: screen_record.zoom_auto
verbs.description: Redo automatic recording zooms from the events journal. keep_manual defaults true; automatic segments overlapping manual segments are discarded. config accepts the screen_record.autoedit engine configuration. Stores the concrete list in one op so replay never reads events. Update video first before export.

verbs.name: screen_record.take_link
verbs.description: Internal polish provenance commit. Register one new recording take with concrete source, events, immutable plan and clip ids. Does not render or insert media.

recording.description: Resolved recording provenance written by polish.

verbs.result: {take} — durable recording provenance; legacy polished clips remain ordinary media.

verbs.name: screen_record.zoom_set
verbs.description: Replace take zooms in one undoable op; empty disables zoom. Split clips share edits. Stale until take_refresh: Update video before export.
verbs.result: {clip, segments, stale} — segments are recording-time milliseconds; Update video first to apply stale edits to playback or export.

verbs.name: screen_record.make_editable
verbs.description: Turn an earlier polished screen recording (0.6.116-0.6.118) into an editable take when its capture files still exist; keeps the original video and reverts in one Undo.
verbs.result: {clip, take, stale, segments, camera_clip, camera_asset} — refuses in plain words with reason and suggested action when files are gone or the recording is too old.

verbs.name: screen_record.take_refresh
verbs.description: Queue Update video; poll jobs.status. Swaps every take clip preserving edits. Refuses duration mismatch over one frame or concurrent edits. After verified completion the previous render and its asset are KEPT, so project.undo right after Update video brings the earlier picture back at once (redo gives the new one); the reply's earlier_render says status kept and where older recording videos are removed (Settings > Old recording renders, screen_record.render_cache_preview / render_cache_remove with confirm). Rebuilds missing/pruned files and repairs assets. Duration reference: stored probe, old file, then plan/source.
verbs.result: {job_id, clip, asset, baked, cached, applied_plan, earlier_render?:{status,bytes?,reason?,message}} — earlier_render reports status kept with the message "Earlier video kept so Undo brings it back at once. To remove older recording videos, open Settings > Old recording renders." on completion; final asset and applied_plan are reported on job completion. A failed bake leaves the take stale and clips unchanged; Update video first before export.
